records.literal_gloss: Only [the] tribe of Levi not you will enroll, and their head not you will lift up in [the] midst of [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: "Only the tribe of Levi you will not enroll, and their head you will not lift up among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: "The one tribe you are not to enroll is Levi. Do not include them in the census of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: "Do not count the tribe of Levi. Leave them out when you count the other {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: «Solamente la tribu de Leví no alistarás, y su cabeza no levantarás en medio de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: «La única tribu que no debes alistar es la de Leví. No la incluyas en el censo de los israelitas.
es.R: «No cuentes a la tribu de Leví. Déjala fuera cuando cuentes a los demás israelitas.

fr.L: « Seulement, la tribu de Lévi, tu ne la recenseras pas, et tu ne lèveras pas leur tête parmi les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: « La seule tribu que tu ne recenseras pas, c’est celle de Lévi. Ne l’inclus pas dans le recensement des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: « Ne compte pas la tribu de Lévi. Laisse-la de côté quand tu comptes les autres {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: "Ila kabila la Lawi usiliandikishe, wala usiinue kichwa chao kati ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: "Kabila moja tu ambalo hupaswi kuliandikisha ni la Lawi. Usiwatie katika hesabu ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: "Usilihesabu kabila la Lawi. Waache nje unapowahesabu Waisraeli wengine.

vi.L: "Chỉ có chi tộc Lê-vi thì ngươi không được kiểm kê, và ngươi không được tính đầu người của họ giữa con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: "Chi tộc duy nhất con không được kiểm kê là Lê-vi. Con không được tính họ vào cuộc kiểm tra dân số của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: "Đừng đếm chi tộc Lê-vi. Khi con đếm những người Y-sơ-ra-ên khác, đừng tính họ vào.

ko.L: "오직 레위 지파는 계수하지 말고, 이스라엘 자손 가운데서 그들의 머릿수를 세지 말라.
ko.B: "레위 지파만은 계수하지 말라. 이스라엘 백성의 인구 조사에 그들을 넣지 말라.
ko.R: "레위 지파는 세면 안 된다. 다른 이스라엘 사람들을 셀 때 그들은 빼야 한다.

pt.L: "Somente a tribo de Levi não recensearás, e a cabeça deles não levantarás no meio dos filhos de Israel.
pt.B: "A única tribo que não recensearás é a de Levi. Não a incluas no recenseamento dos israelitas.
pt.R: "Não contes a tribo de Levi. Deixa os levitas de fora quando contares os outros israelitas.

am.L: «የሌዊን ነገድ ብቻ አትቁጠር፤ ራሳቸውንም በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል አታንሣ።
am.B: «ልትመዘግበው የማይገባህ ብቸኛው ነገድ ሌዊ ነው። በእስራኤል ልጆች ቆጠራ ውስጥ አታስገባቸው።
am.R: «የሌዊን ነገድ አትቁጠር። ሌሎቹን እስራኤላውያን ስትቆጥር እነርሱን ተዋቸው።

decisions.choice: only: Levi is the one exception
decisions.reason: The word marks an exception to the command of verses 2-3: count every tribe, but not Levi.

decisions.choice: lift up their head: count them
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: The one tribe you are not to enroll is Levi.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts "the tribe of Levi" first for emphasis. Balanced keeps the emphasis with "the one tribe".

decisions.choice: "tú" (singular): "no alistarás", "no debes alistar", "no cuentes"
decisions.reason: Here the LORD speaks to Moses alone (the Hebrew verbs are singular), unlike the plural command of verses 2-3, so Spanish uses "tú" and has no plural_you span. French and Swahili make the same change ("tu", "u-").

decisions.choice: tu (recensearás, levantarás; contes, Deixa)
decisions.reason: Here the command is singular, to Moses alone, so Portuguese uses "tu", where verses 2-3 speak to Moses and Aaron with "vocês". Literal keeps the idiom "levantar a cabeça" (m2), as in verse 2.

source.text: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַפְקֵ֣ד אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם֩ עַל־מִשְׁכַּ֨ן הָעֵדֻ֜ת וְעַ֣ל כָּל־כֵּלָיו֮ וְעַ֣ל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֒ הֵ֜מָּה יִשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְהֵ֖ם יְשָׁרְתֻ֑הוּ וְסָבִ֥יב לַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, appoint the Levites over [the] tabernacle of the testimony and over all its vessels and over all that [belongs] to it; they will carry the tabernacle and all its vessels, and they will serve it, and around the tabernacle they will camp.

en.L: But you, appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that [belongs] to it. They will carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings, and they will serve it, and around the tabernacle they will camp.
en.B: Instead, put the Levites in charge of the tabernacle of the testimony, all its furnishings and everything that belongs to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings, look after it, and camp around the tabernacle.
en.R: Instead, put the Levites in charge of the tabernacle, the tent where the covenant tablets are kept. They are in charge of all its equipment and everything that belongs to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and its equipment. They must take care of it and set up their tents all around it.

es.L: Pero tú, pon a los levitas sobre el tabernáculo del Testimonio, y sobre todos sus utensilios, y sobre todo lo que [le pertenece]. Ellos llevarán el tabernáculo y todos sus utensilios, y ellos lo servirán, y alrededor del tabernáculo acamparán.
es.B: Más bien, pon a los levitas a cargo del tabernáculo del Testimonio, de todo su mobiliario y de todo lo que le pertenece. Ellos deben llevar el tabernáculo y todo su mobiliario, cuidarlo y acampar alrededor del tabernáculo.
es.R: Más bien, pon a los levitas a cargo del tabernáculo, la tienda donde se guardan las tablas del pacto. Ellos están a cargo de todos sus objetos y de todo lo que le pertenece. Deben cargar el tabernáculo y sus objetos. Tienen que cuidarlo y poner sus tiendas alrededor de él.

fr.L: Mais toi, établis les Lévites sur la Demeure du Témoignage, et sur tous ses objets, et sur tout ce qui [est] à elle. Eux porteront la Demeure et tous ses objets, et eux la serviront, et autour de la Demeure ils camperont.
fr.B: Confie plutôt aux Lévites la charge de la Demeure du Témoignage, de tout son mobilier et de tout ce qui lui appartient. Ce sont eux qui porteront la Demeure et tout son mobilier, qui en prendront soin et qui camperont autour d’elle.
fr.R: Charge plutôt les Lévites de s’occuper de la Demeure, la tente où sont gardées les tablettes de l’alliance. Ils sont responsables de tout son matériel et de tout ce qui lui appartient. Ils doivent porter la Demeure et son matériel. Ils doivent en prendre soin et installer leurs tentes tout autour.

sw.L: Bali wewe, waweke Walawi juu ya maskani ya Ushuhuda, na juu ya vyombo vyake vyote, na juu ya vyote [vilivyo] vyake. Wao wataibeba maskani na vyombo vyake vyote, nao wataihudumia, na kuizunguka maskani watapiga kambi.
sw.B: Badala yake, uwape Walawi jukumu la kusimamia maskani ya Ushuhuda, vyombo vyake vyote na kila kitu kilicho chake. Wao ndio watakaoibeba maskani na vyombo vyake vyote, kuitunza, na kupiga kambi kuizunguka.
sw.R: Badala yake, uwape Walawi kazi ya kusimamia maskani, yaani hema ambamo vibao vya agano vinatunzwa. Wao ndio wenye jukumu juu ya vifaa vyake vyote na kila kitu kilicho chake. Wataibeba maskani na vifaa vyake. Lazima waitunze na kupiga hema zao kuizunguka pande zote.

vi.L: Nhưng ngươi, hãy lập người Lê-vi coi sóc Đền Tạm chứng ước, mọi vật dụng của nó và mọi thứ thuộc về nó. Họ sẽ khiêng Đền Tạm và mọi vật dụng của nó, họ sẽ phục vụ nó, và họ sẽ đóng trại chung quanh Đền Tạm.
vi.B: Thay vào đó, con hãy giao cho người Lê-vi coi sóc Đền Tạm chứng ước, mọi vật dụng và mọi thứ thuộc về Đền Tạm. Họ phải khiêng Đền Tạm và mọi vật dụng của nó, phục vụ trong đó, và đóng trại chung quanh Đền Tạm.
vi.R: Thay vào đó, con hãy giao cho người Lê-vi trông coi Đền Tạm, là cái lều nơi cất giữ hai bảng giao ước. Họ phải trông coi mọi đồ dùng và mọi thứ thuộc về Đền Tạm. Họ phải khiêng Đền Tạm và các đồ dùng của nó. Họ phải chăm lo Đền Tạm và dựng lều mình chung quanh đó.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 레위인을 증거의 성막과 그 모든 기구와 그것에 [딸린] 모든 것 위에 세워라. 그들이 성막과 그 모든 기구를 메고, 그것을 섬기며, 성막 둘레에 진을 칠 것이다.
ko.B: 그 대신 레위인에게 증거의 성막과 그 모든 기구와 거기에 딸린 모든 것을 맡겨라. 그들은 성막과 그 모든 기구를 운반하고, 성막을 돌보며, 성막 둘레에 진을 쳐야 한다.
ko.R: 그 대신 레위인에게 성막, 곧 언약의 돌판을 넣어 둔 장막을 맡겨야 한다. 성막의 모든 기구와 거기에 딸린 모든 것도 그들이 맡는다. 그들은 성막과 그 기구들을 옮겨야 한다. 또 성막을 돌보고, 성막 둘레에 천막을 치고 지내야 한다.

pt.L: Mas tu, designa os levitas sobre o tabernáculo do Testemunho, e sobre todos os seus utensílios, e sobre tudo o que [pertence] a ele. Eles carregarão o tabernáculo e todos os seus utensílios, e eles o servirão, e ao redor do tabernáculo acamparão.
pt.B: Em vez disso, põe os levitas como responsáveis pelo tabernáculo do Testemunho, por todos os seus utensílios e por tudo o que lhe pertence. Eles carregarão o tabernáculo e todos os seus utensílios, cuidarão dele e acamparão ao redor do tabernáculo.
pt.R: Em vez disso, põe os levitas como responsáveis pelo tabernáculo, a tenda onde ficam as tábuas da aliança. Eles devem cuidar de todos os objetos do tabernáculo e de tudo o que pertence a ele. Eles devem carregar o tabernáculo e os seus objetos. Devem cuidar dele e armar as suas tendas ao redor dele.

am.L: አንተ ግን ሌዋውያንን በምስክሩ ማደሪያ ላይ፣ በዕቃዎቹም ሁሉ ላይ፣ ለእርሱም በሆነው ሁሉ ላይ ሹማቸው። እነርሱ ማደሪያውንና ዕቃዎቹን ሁሉ ይሸከማሉ፤ ያገለግሉታልም፤ በማደሪያውም ዙሪያ ይሰፍራሉ።
am.B: ይልቁንም ሌዋውያንን በምስክሩ ማደሪያ፣ በዕቃዎቹ ሁሉና የእርሱ በሆነው ነገር ሁሉ ላይ ኃላፊዎች አድርጋቸው። እነርሱ ማደሪያውንና ዕቃዎቹን ሁሉ ይሸከሙ፤ ይንከባከቡትም፤ በማደሪያውም ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ።
am.R: ይልቁንም ሌዋውያንን በማደሪያው ድንኳን ላይ ኃላፊዎች አድርጋቸው፤ ይህ ድንኳን የቃል ኪዳኑ ጽላቶች የተቀመጡበት ነው። ዕቃዎቹ ሁሉና የእርሱ የሆነው ነገር ሁሉ በእነርሱ ኃላፊነት ሥር ነው። ማደሪያውንና ዕቃዎቹን መሸከም አለባቸው። እርሱን መንከባከብና ድንኳኖቻቸውን በዙሪያው መትከል አለባቸው።

decisions.choice: appoint: the same verb as "enroll", used in another sense
decisions.reason: The verb that means "enroll" in verse 49 means "appoint" or "put in charge" here. Moses is not to enroll the Levites for war; he is to appoint them over the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle of the testimony: the tent that held the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: The testimony is the two tablets of the covenant kept in the ark (Exodus 25:16, 21). The tabernacle is named after them here and in verse 53 (Exodus 38:21).

decisions.choice: serve it: do the work of the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The verb is used of the service done at the sanctuary, by priests and by Levites. For the Levites it means looking after the tent and its furnishings and carrying them (3:6-8; 4:4-33).

decisions.choice: the tent where the covenant tablets are kept
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the testimony", as in Exodus 38:21.

decisions.choice: furnishings / equipment
decisions.reason: The word means vessels, utensils or equipment of any kind: here the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars and their tools (3:31; 4:5-15).

decisions.choice: "el tabernáculo del Testimonio"; "los levitas"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Numbers, as the Pentateuch terms list sets: the tabernacle is "el tabernáculo" and the testimony "el Testimonio", the covenant tablets (m2), which Readable explains, as the English does, as "la tienda donde se guardan las tablas del pacto".

decisions.choice: "la Demeure du Témoignage" at every level; "les Lévites"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Numbers, as the Pentateuch terms list sets: the tabernacle (mishkan, "dwelling") is "la Demeure", which says what the word means, the place where the LORD dwells among his people; "tabernacle" today calls up the box for the sacrament in a Catholic church. The testimony is "le Témoignage", the covenant tablets (m2); Readable explains it, as the English does, as "la tente où sont gardées les tablettes de l'alliance".

decisions.choice: "maskani ya Ushuhuda"; "Walawi"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Numbers, as the Pentateuch terms list sets: the tabernacle (mishkan, "dwelling") is "maskani", the dwelling-place, and the testimony "Ushuhuda", the covenant tablets (m2), which Readable explains, as the English does, as "hema ambamo vibao vya agano vinatunzwa".

decisions.choice: "증거의 성막" (Literal, Balanced); "성막, 곧 언약의 돌판을 넣어 둔 장막" (Readable); "기구" for its furnishings
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and Exodus 38:21 in Korean: "성막" for the tabernacle and "증거" for the testimony, with the Readable saying what the testimony is. "기구" covers both the English "furnishings" and "equipment".

decisions.choice: "Đền Tạm chứng ước" (L, B), explained at Readable as "cái lều nơi cất giữ hai bảng giao ước"; "vật dụng" (L, B) / "đồ dùng" (R) for its furnishings
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words, as Exodus 38:21 already renders the same phrase, with the same Readable explanation. "vật dụng" covers the sacred furniture and utensils without suggesting household furniture.

decisions.choice: o tabernáculo do Testemunho; os utensílios (L, B), os objetos (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "o Testemunho" takes a capital, as in "a arca do Testemunho" and Exodus 38:21, since it names the covenant tablets (m2). The word for the tent's "furnishings" covers every kind of vessel and implement (r-en-2): "utensílios" at Literal and Balanced, "objetos" at Readable; "móveis" would leave out the tools.

decisions.choice: "የምስክሩ ማደሪያ" (L, B) and "ማደሪያው ድንኳን ... የቃል ኪዳኑ ጽላቶች የተቀመጡበት" (R), as Exodus 38:21; "ዕቃዎቹ" for its furnishings at every level.
decisions.reason: One word for the tabernacle's vessels through chapters 1-4, so that the lists in chapter 4 read as the same things; "ዕቃ" covers furniture and utensils alike.

source.text: וּבִנְסֹ֣עַ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יוֹרִ֤ידוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וּבַחֲנֹת֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹת֖וֹ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And when sets out the tabernacle, will take it down the Levites, and when camps the tabernacle, will set it up the Levites; and the outsider who comes near will be put to death.

en.L: And when the tabernacle sets out, the Levites will take it down, and when the tabernacle camps, the Levites will set it up; and the outsider who comes near will be put to death.
en.B: Whenever the tabernacle is to move on, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who comes near it is to be put to death.
en.R: When it is time to move the tabernacle, the Levites must take it down. When it is time to set it up again, the Levites must do it. Anyone else who comes near it must be put to death.

es.L: Y cuando parta el tabernáculo, los levitas lo desarmarán, y cuando acampe el tabernáculo, los levitas lo levantarán; y el extraño que se acerque será muerto.
es.B: Cada vez que el tabernáculo tenga que trasladarse, los levitas lo desarmarán, y cada vez que haya que instalarlo, los levitas lo armarán. Cualquier extraño que se acerque a él será condenado a muerte.
es.R: Cuando sea hora de mover el tabernáculo, los levitas tienen que desarmarlo. Cuando sea hora de armarlo otra vez, los levitas deben hacerlo. Cualquier otra persona que se acerque a él debe ser ejecutada.

fr.L: Et quand la Demeure partira, les Lévites la démonteront, et quand la Demeure campera, les Lévites la dresseront ; et le profane qui s’approchera sera mis à mort.
fr.B: Chaque fois que la Demeure devra partir, les Lévites la démonteront, et chaque fois qu’il faudra l’installer, ce sont les Lévites qui la dresseront. Tout profane qui s’en approchera sera mis à mort.
fr.R: Quand il faudra déplacer la Demeure, ce sont les Lévites qui doivent la démonter. Quand il faudra l’installer de nouveau, ce sont aussi les Lévites qui doivent le faire. Toute autre personne qui s’en approche doit être mise à mort.

sw.L: Na maskani itakapong'oa, Walawi wataishusha, na maskani itakapopiga kambi, Walawi wataisimika; na mtu wa nje atakayekaribia atauawa.
sw.B: Kila maskani inapopaswa kuondoka, Walawi wataifungua, na kila inapopaswa kusimikwa, Walawi wataisimika. Mtu yeyote wa nje atakayeikaribia atauawa.
sw.R: Wakati wa kuihamisha maskani ukifika, lazima Walawi waifungue. Wakati wa kuisimika tena ukifika, Walawi ndio watakaofanya hivyo. Mtu mwingine yeyote atakayeikaribia lazima auawe.

vi.L: Và khi Đền Tạm ra đi, người Lê-vi sẽ tháo nó xuống; và khi Đền Tạm đóng trại, người Lê-vi sẽ dựng nó lên; và người ngoài nào đến gần sẽ bị xử tử.
vi.B: Mỗi khi Đền Tạm phải dời đi, người Lê-vi phải tháo nó xuống; mỗi khi phải dựng Đền Tạm, người Lê-vi phải dựng nó lên. Người ngoài nào đến gần sẽ bị xử tử.
vi.R: Khi đến lúc dời Đền Tạm, người Lê-vi phải tháo nó xuống. Khi đến lúc dựng lại, người Lê-vi phải dựng lên. Bất cứ ai khác đến gần Đền Tạm đều phải bị xử tử.

ko.L: 그리고 성막이 떠날 때에는 레위인이 그것을 걷고, 성막이 진을 칠 때에는 레위인이 그것을 세울 것이다. 그리고 가까이 오는 외부인은 죽임을 당할 것이다.
ko.B: 성막을 옮길 때마다 레위인이 그것을 걷고, 성막을 칠 때마다 레위인이 그것을 세워야 한다. 외부인이 성막에 가까이 오면 죽임을 당해야 한다.
ko.R: 성막을 옮길 때가 되면 레위인이 그것을 걷어야 한다. 다시 세울 때가 되면 레위인이 세워야 한다. 레위인이 아닌 사람이 성막에 가까이 오면 죽여야 한다.

pt.L: E quando o tabernáculo partir, os levitas o desmontarão, e quando o tabernáculo acampar, os levitas o montarão; e o estranho que se aproximar será morto.
pt.B: Sempre que o tabernáculo tiver de partir, os levitas o desmontarão, e sempre que tiver de ser armado, os levitas o montarão. Qualquer estranho que se aproximar dele será morto.
pt.R: Quando for o momento de mudar o tabernáculo de lugar, os levitas devem desmontá-lo. Quando for o momento de armá-lo de novo, os levitas devem fazer isso. Qualquer outra pessoa que chegar perto dele deve ser morta.

am.L: ማደሪያውም በሚነሣበት ጊዜ ሌዋውያን ይነቅሉታል፤ ማደሪያውም በሚሰፍርበት ጊዜ ሌዋውያን ይተክሉታል፤ የሚቀርበውም እንግዳ ይገደላል።
am.B: ማደሪያው በሚነሣበት ጊዜ ሁሉ ሌዋውያን ይንቀሉት፤ በሚተከልበትም ጊዜ ሁሉ ሌዋውያን ይትከሉት። ሌዋዊ ያልሆነ ማንም ሰው ወደ እርሱ ቢቀርብ ይገደል።
am.R: ማደሪያውን ማንቀሳቀስ ሲያስፈልግ ሌዋውያን ሊነቅሉት ይገባል። እንደገና መትከል ሲያስፈልግም ሌዋውያን ይትከሉት። ሌላ ማንም ሰው ቢቀርበው መገደል አለበት።

decisions.choice: the outsider: anyone who is not a Levite
decisions.reason: The word means someone who does not belong to the group in question, not necessarily a foreigner. Here it is any Israelite outside the tribe of Levi; elsewhere it means anyone who is not a priest (3:10; 18:7).

decisions.choice: will be put to death: the penalty set by the law
decisions.reason: The passive form is the usual wording for the death penalty in the law (Exodus 19:12; 21:12). It guards the holy things from careless approach; 4:15, 20 warn that even Levites will die if they touch or look at them wrongly.

decisions.choice: sets out ... camps: the words used of the whole camp on the march
decisions.reason: The tabernacle "sets out" and "camps" with the people. The same two verbs describe Israel's moves throughout the wilderness journey (9:17-23; 10:12; 33:1-49).

decisions.choice: Anyone else
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who the outsider is here: anyone who is not a Levite (m1).

decisions.choice: "el extraño", "cualquier extraño"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means anyone outside the group concerned, here anyone who is not a Levite (m1); "extraño" (an outsider) says that without the sense of a foreign nationality that "extranjero", the word for the immigrant (ger), has. Readable says plainly "cualquier otra persona".

decisions.choice: "le profane", "tout profane"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means anyone outside the group concerned, here anyone who is not a Levite (m1), not a foreigner; "l'étranger" is kept for the immigrant (ger). "Profane" is the French word for someone outside a sacred office who may not handle what is holy. Readable says plainly "toute autre personne", as the English says "anyone else".

decisions.choice: "mtu wa nje" (an outsider)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means anyone outside the group concerned, here anyone who is not a Levite (m1). "Mgeni" is kept for the foreigner (ger) and would suggest a stranger to Israel; "mtu wa nje" is someone outside the group. Readable says "mtu mwingine yeyote", as the English says "anyone else".

decisions.choice: "người ngoài" for the outsider (zar)
decisions.reason: The word means anyone who is not a Levite, not a foreigner; "người lạ" would suggest a stranger to the people. Used for the same word in 3:10, 38.

decisions.choice: "외부인" (Literal, Balanced) and "레위인이 아닌 사람" (Readable) for "the outsider"
decisions.reason: "외부인" is the word Korean Exodus 29:33 uses for the same Hebrew word; here the outsider is anyone who is not a Levite, as the meaning decision says, and the Readable says so plainly.

decisions.choice: o estranho (L); qualquer estranho (B)
decisions.reason: The word means someone outside the group, here any Israelite who is not a Levite (m1), not a foreigner, so Portuguese says "estranho", not "estrangeiro". Readable says "qualquer outra pessoa", as the English Readable says "anyone else".

decisions.choice: "እንግዳ" (L) and "ሌዋዊ ያልሆነ ማንም ሰው" (B) for the outsider (zar); at 3:10 and 3:38 "ካህን ያልሆነ".
decisions.reason: The word means anyone not authorised for the task, here any non-Levite Israelite, not a foreigner; "ባዕድ" would point to a foreigner.

source.text: וְחָנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֧ישׁ עַֽל־מַחֲנֵ֛הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ עַל־דִּגְל֖וֹ לְצִבְאֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will camp [the] sons of Israel, a man by his camp and a man by his standard, by their armies.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel will camp, {{gender:each one|each man}} by {{gender:their|his}} camp and {{gender:each one|each man}} by {{gender:their|his}} standard, by their armies.
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} are to camp by their divisions, {{gender:everyone|each man}} in {{gender:their|his}} own camp and under {{gender:their|his}} own standard.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} must camp by their troops, {{gender:everyone|each man}} in {{gender:their|his}} own camp and under {{gender:their|his}} own flag.

es.L: Y acamparán los hijos de Israel, cada uno junto a su campamento y cada uno junto a su estandarte, según sus ejércitos.
es.B: Los israelitas acamparán por divisiones, cada uno en su propio campamento y bajo su propio estandarte.
es.R: Los israelitas deben acampar por tropas, cada uno en su campamento y bajo su propia bandera.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël camperont, chacun près de son camp et chacun près de sa bannière, selon leurs armées.
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} camperont par divisions, chacun dans son propre camp et sous sa propre bannière.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} doivent camper par troupes, chacun dans son propre camp et sous son propre drapeau.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli watapiga kambi, kila mtu kwenye kambi yake na kila mtu kwenye bendera yake, kwa majeshi yao.
sw.B: Waisraeli watapiga kambi kwa vikosi vyao, kila mtu katika kambi yake mwenyewe na chini ya bendera yake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Lazima Waisraeli wapige kambi kwa vikosi vyao, kila mtu katika kambi yake na chini ya bendera yake.

vi.L: Và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ đóng trại, mỗi người theo trại quân mình và mỗi người theo cờ hiệu mình, theo các đạo quân của họ.
vi.B: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phải đóng trại theo từng đội quân, mỗi người ở trong trại quân của mình và dưới cờ hiệu của mình.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phải đóng trại theo từng đội quân. Mỗi người ở trong khu trại của mình, dưới lá cờ của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손은 각자 자기 진에, 각자 자기 깃발 곁에, 그들의 군대별로 진을 칠 것이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성은 부대별로 진을 치되, 저마다 자기 진에, 자기 깃발 아래 진을 쳐야 한다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람들은 부대별로 진을 쳐야 한다. 저마다 자기 진에서 자기 깃발 아래 머물러야 한다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel acamparão, cada um no seu acampamento e cada um junto ao seu estandarte, segundo os seus exércitos.
pt.B: Os israelitas acamparão segundo as suas divisões, cada um no seu próprio acampamento e junto ao seu próprio estandarte.
pt.R: Os israelitas devem acampar por tropas, cada um no seu próprio acampamento e debaixo da sua própria bandeira.

am.L: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እያንዳንዱ በሰፈሩ፣ እያንዳንዱም በዓላማው፣ በየሠራዊታቸው ይሰፍራሉ።
am.B: የእስራኤል ልጆች በየክፍለ ሠራዊታቸው ይስፈሩ፤ እያንዳንዱ በራሱ ሰፈርና በራሱ ዓላማ ሥር ይስፈር።
am.R: እስራኤላውያን በየጭፍራቸው መስፈር አለባቸው። እያንዳንዱ በራሱ ሰፈርና በራሱ ሰንደቅ ዓላማ ሥር ይስፈር።

decisions.choice: standard: the banner of a group in the camp
decisions.reason: The word means a flag or banner that marks a group. In chapter 2 the tribes camp in four groups of three around the tabernacle, each group under one standard (2:2-31).

decisions.choice: a man ... a man: each one
decisions.reason: "A man" repeated means "each". The whole people camps this way, households and all, not only the men just counted.

decisions.choice: each one / everyone, with "each man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Since the whole people is meant (m2), the inclusive wording is the default and the traditional "each man" the alternative.

decisions.choice: "cada uno", "su" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts "each one ... their" under the gender setting because the whole people is meant (m2). Spanish "cada uno" already includes everyone and "su" has no gender, so Spanish has no second wording for the setting to change. The standard is "estandarte" at Literal and Balanced and "bandera" at Readable, as the English says "flag".

decisions.choice: "chacun", "son", "sa" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts "each one ... their" under the gender setting because the whole people is meant (m2). French "chacun" already means anyone, man or woman, and the possessive agrees with the thing possessed, so French has no second wording for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "mỗi người" for "a man ... a man", with no gender span
alternatives: a span such as "mỗi người nam"
decisions.reason: "mỗi người" names everyone without marking gender, so Vietnamese has only one wording here for the English "each one" / "each man" setting.

decisions.choice: "trại quân" (L, B) / "khu trại" (R) for the camp; "cờ hiệu" (L, B) / "lá cờ" (R) for the standard
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words for the camp. "cờ hiệu" is a banner that marks a group, which is what the standard is; Readable says simply "lá cờ", as the English Readable says "flag". Book-wide for Numbers 1-5.

decisions.choice: "깃발" for the standard at every level; "각자" / "저마다" for "a man", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "깃발" serves both the English "standard" and "flag"; "저마다" already includes everyone, so the gender setting has nothing to change in Korean.

decisions.choice: cada um, with no gender setting
alternatives: cada homem, under a gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting because "each man" names only men, but the whole people is meant (m2), and Portuguese "cada um" already means everyone, as the inclusive default would; so there is nothing for a setting to change.

decisions.choice: o estandarte (L, B); a bandeira (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the word is the banner that marks a group in the camp (m1). "Estandarte" is the Portuguese word for a military banner; Readable says "bandeira", as the English Readable says "flag". Chapter 2 uses the same pair.

decisions.choice: "እያንዳንዱ ... በራሱ" with no gender span.
alternatives: a gender span with "እያንዳንዱ ወንድ" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Amharic "እያንዳንዱ" with the generic masculine suffix is already the inclusive form, so the English span has nothing to switch in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "ዓላማ" (L, B) and "ሰንደቅ ዓላማ" (R) for the standard (degel), through chapters 1, 2 and 10.
decisions.reason: "ዓላማ" is the older word for a banner carried on a pole; Readable adds "ሰንደቅ", the everyday word for a flag. "ባንዲራ" suggests a national flag.

source.text: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם יַחֲנ֤וּ סָבִיב֙ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה קֶ֔צֶף עַל־עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֽוּת׃

decisions.choice: wrath: God's anger when what is holy is treated carelessly
decisions.reason: The word is used of the LORD's anger breaking out against the people when the holy place is wrongly approached (17:11; 18:5; Leviticus 10:6). The Levites' camp around the tent is a guard that protects the people from coming too near.

decisions.choice: keep the charge: stand guard and carry out the duties
decisions.reason: The word means a watch or duty to be kept. For the Levites it is both guarding the tent against intruders and doing its work (3:7-8, 38; 18:3-5).

decisions.choice: my anger
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "there will be no wrath". The LORD is speaking, and the wrath is his (m1), so Readable says "my anger".

decisions.choice: guard the tabernacle and take care of it
decisions.reason: Readable gives both sides of the word "charge" (m2).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo
decisions.reason: For the whole of Numbers, as in Genesis and Exodus: the deity pronoun setting goes on the Spanish words for God that Spanish writes out (él, lo, le, su, mí, mi, me, tú, te, ti, tu); where Spanish has no separate word for the English pronoun, there is no span. Here Readable says "my anger", as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère
decisions.reason: For the whole of Numbers, as in Genesis and Exodus: every pronoun for God takes the deity pronoun setting, lowercase by default and capitalised as the alternative (il, lui, le, l', son, sa, ses, and moi, me, mon, ma, mes, toi, te, tu, ton when God speaks or is spoken to, including an inverted "-tu"). "Je" has no span, and a pronoun that opens a sentence is written plainly with its capital. Here Readable says "my anger", as the English does.

decisions.choice: hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}
decisions.reason: For the whole of Numbers, as in Genesis and Exodus: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb, where no capital is possible, so the deity pronoun setting goes only on free pronouns for God (yeye, naye, mimi, nami, wewe, and the possessives wake, yake, wangu, yangu, yako...). Here Readable says "my anger", as the English does, and the possessive "yangu" takes the span.

decisions.choice: "giữ phận sự canh giữ" (L), "canh giữ" (B) for "keep the charge"
decisions.reason: The phrase joins guarding with carrying out set duties; "phận sự" keeps the sense of an assigned duty. Used for the same phrase in chapters 3-4.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun span on "나의 진노"
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting the English marks on "my" has nothing to change; God's words keep the plain "나", as the Korean style guide sets for the whole Bible.

decisions.choice: they did ... so they did: complete obedience
decisions.reason: Saying "they did" at the start and "so they did" at the end stresses that the people did all they were told, as when the tabernacle was finished (Exodus 39:32, 42-43; 40:16).

decisions.choice: exactly
decisions.reason: Readable gives the force of the repeated "so they did" with "exactly" instead of repeating the verb.
